results.title: [PDF] Original Article - Journal of Health Science and Medical Research
results.content: # Abstract: Objective : To evaluate the effects of a blended aqueous extract of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina on some markers of thromboinflammation in diabetic rats. Conclusion: This study revealed that the blended aqueous extracts of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina are non-toxic and may have synergistic effects in limiting thromboinflammation in a diabetic state.
